question: Does head04/body04 improve source-like construction or introduce coarse angular regressions?

independence.sources: Pinned full-bird/July head; integration04 four builder renders; attempt03 before; head04/body04 attempt02 clay/material-ID diagnostics. Scripts inspected after visual judgment.
independence.excluded: Worker handoffs and other QA conclusions unread. No children or repository edits.
independence.limits: Shared model/context; supplemental role, not completed three-role equilibrium review. No owner acceptance.

regional_decisions.finding: New clay front/45/profile proves actual depth and removes the before render’s thin parallel bill cards. A distinct deep hook improves avian identity. Preserve this volumetric approach, not every current contour.

Broad segmented dome and large projecting circular housing replace source’s swept brow integrated into cheek bands. Beneath the optic, a straight skull cutoff over a very large aperture and thin bowed jaw rails read detached. Source has a substantial curving cheek frame and nested lower jaw, not an empty hanging loop. Faceting persists in clay.

Local formation trades the before’s smooth scales for heavy angular stepped tiles. Clay grazing/front show broad flat faces, raised rectangular roots, sparse breast coverage and stand-off gaps. The source has thinner curved, denser, contour-following feather plates. Neck laminae remain sparse around exposed rails. Compact shield envelope is useful; new coarse tile language is a regression.

Compact rear, mechanical legs and flightless identity survive. Complete bird still reads narrow/upright and simply plated relative to canon. Estimated near-side camera can distort mass comparisons; no calibrated proportion claim.

top_three_geometry_fixes: Keep body envelope but replace broad hard two-face tiles with thinner curved, tapered source-shaped plates; tighten overlap across shield, breast and neck while reducing raised roots and gaps.
Join orbital rim, cheek band and beak root into a coherent layered facial frame; reduce projecting eye housing and rebuild substantial lower-jaw curvature around the opening.
Sweep roof plates into the forehead/bill saddle with continuous convex sections and controlled seams; eliminate exposed coarse crown facets and blocky transverse ridges.
confounds: Camera03/04 are estimated and too side-biased for definitive canon mass comparison. Finish/color encoding is under separate review; body plate regression and cheek discontinuity survive clay isolation. July controls head only; its body excluded.
acceptance: Not a full-target match; no release, browser, deployment or human acceptance claim.
